# Introducing Zero Wire, a hub for investigating critical Internet vulnerabilities

Daniele MolteniCelso Martinho

Daniele Molteni and Celso Martinho

8 minute read [...] ## Our focus

Rather than a catalog of every CVE, Zero Wire complements vendor advisories and vulnerability databases, linking readers to the evidence and technical guidance needed to act. Zero Wire focuses on critical CVEs in Internet-facing software, such as vulnerabilities in web applications, the runtimes and libraries they depend on, and services exposed to the Internet, where a proxy can help mitigate exploitation. [...] Visit Zero Wire vulnerability intelligence, share the relevant briefings with the teams responsible for your systems, and return for new entries and updates. When the next disclosure arrives, we want you to spend less time assembling the basic facts and more time acting on them.

Follow Cloudflare Radar on X @CloudflareRadar and Bluesky @radar.cloudflare.com for updates.
